system.description:
When you call upon your blood you burst into a whirlwind of motion, snuffing small flames, whipping up flurries of debris and sowing confusion among slower-moving creatures.

Spend a single Blood Trait to activate all of your Celerity powers. For the whole of that turn you win all ties in challenges of speed regardless of Traits; if some other factor would otherwise cost you a tie (such as wounds, or an enemy's Potence), you compare Traits normally instead of losing automatically. Fleetness works in any challenge where you rely on speed even if your opponent uses strength or stamina — against an opponent whose power also wins all ties (such as another's Fleetness or Puissance) ties are simply resolved normally, and against a foe with only Might you win ties but remain vulnerable to his Might retest. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
